wholePhysicalScope: The mapped three-storey outline encloses the independently named hotel node with the street number, and street alignments establish the orientation.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the mapped brick corner, steep roof and two levels of open cast-iron verandas.
limitations: Draft exterior: approximate photographic proportions and simplified ornament. It is not a survey, photogrammetric reconstruction or approved current geographic replacement.
